title: First Person Viewer
author: Flying Madman
description: A young mage discovers forbidden magic in her grandmother's attic. She must master these dark arts before the Inquisition arrives. Time is running out as ancient forces awaken.

title: Broken Clocks
author: GeneralOne
description: In a world where memories can be stolen, a thief loses his own past. He races through neon-lit streets searching for the truth. Every clue leads deeper into a corporate conspiracy.

title: Nowhere Home
author: Admiral Kenobi
description: The last dragon hides in human form at a coffee shop. When hunters close in, she must choose between safety and her true nature. Her decision will determine the fate of all magical beings.
